subject: Prepay tranche, PO template, and weekly invoice ramp for CareGrid
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@caregrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@caregrid.com
Date: 2026-11-20T14:08:00Z
Subject: PO approach and billing cadence questions for enterprise pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. Procurement had a couple of asks before we can issue a formal PO:

- CareGrid needs a PO that includes 3 line items (initial commitment, monthly support, usage overage). Can you accept that structure?
- We prefer a prepay tranche (50% on kickoff) then weekly invoices for consumption, consolidated to a monthly statement for AP.
- Net term request: Net 45 (Org policy). Is that something you can do for an enterprise pilot?
- We also need the Redwood billing contact and a lockbox/ACH option for payments.

Attaching our PO template for your procurement team to review. Appreciate any redlines.

Attachments: CareGrid_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Tara Singh
Sourcing Manager — CareGrid Health
T: +1 415-555-0123


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@caregrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T17:42:00Z
Subject: Re: PO approach and billing cadence questions for enterprise pilot

Tara —

Appreciate the clear ask and the template. Summary response up front: we can match the PO line-item structure and support a 50% upfront tranche, but there are a few constraints from our billing/pricing model that will determine discount eligibility and final net terms.

Key points:
- Discounting and packaging: our volume discounts are tiered and explicitly conditioned on PO fields that tie to a minimum committed MRR or annualized spend. We need the PO to specify the committed dollar amount (not just line item names) to apply the agreed discount.
- Net terms: Net 45 is outside our standard Net 30 for pilot/customer success arrangements. We can escalate Net 45 approval, but it typically requires finance sign-off and a credit review.
- Invoice cadence: Weekly consumption invoices + monthly consolidated statement is fine; however, weekly invoices increase transaction fees and may limit available early-pay discounts.
- Payment rails: we support ACH and lockbox. For lockbox we need a remittance mapping and a three-business-day hold for deposit encoding.

Ben and Vivek — can you confirm if finance can greenlight Net 45 on this pilot (deal RG-2026-1945) and whether we can preserve the discount bands with a 50% prepay?

Next steps:
1) Ben — quick confirmation on Net 45 feasibility and any required PO fields for discounting.
2) Vivek — if finance approves, I’ll send a pricing addendum showing the tranche structure and the conditional discount brackets.
3) Tara — once we align, we’ll return an annotated PO template and the Redwood PRICING_Tranche_Summary.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 617-555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: PO approach and billing cadence questions for enterprise pilot

Marissa, Vivek —

Quick finance read: Net 45 is approvable for pilots on a case-by-case basis, but we need the following on the PO to make the exception without additional risk controls:

- PO must list the committed upfront amount (50% tranche dollar value) and the estimated monthly consumption cap.
- PO should reference Redwood's billing contact and include a remit-to address for lockbox (we will supply this).
- CareGrid must accept a standard invoice hold policy (3 business days) for lockbox deposit processing.
- For discount brackets: we require a signed pricing addendum that ties discounts to the committed annualized spend. Discounts cannot be applied retroactively to usage above the committed amount — overages billed at standard list rates.

If CareGrid is willing to sign the pricing addendum and commit the upfront tranche, we can approve Net 45 for the pilot. If not, Net 30 remains our default.

I will draft the pricing addendum and remit details. Marissa, please share the projected committed spend so I can calculate the discount tier.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Finance Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@caregrid.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: PO approach and billing cadence questions for enterprise pilot

Tara —

Thanks for the template and for being flexible. From GTM perspective, the most important pieces to keep the deal clean are:

- Committed amount (even as a pilot commitment) — this unlocks our price protection and the promotional discount for the first 12 months.
- Prepay + weekly ramp is preferred by CareGrid; to accommodate, we can accept 50% kickoff prepay, then weekly invoices for usage that will net to a single monthly statement for AP.
- We prefer the discount to be structured as a fixed percentage tied to the committed tranche (e.g., 10% off list for committed spend >= $180k ARR annualized). We can be flexible on thresholds for pilots.

Operational ask: Tara, could your team add a short line in the PO: “Committed annualized spend: $XXX,XXX — discounts per attached addendum.” That phrasing avoids ambiguity in billing systems.

I’ll coordinate with legal to keep the addendum lightweight. Ben — please include the lockbox remit and the addendum draft. Marissa — I can own the pricing conversation once we have draft numbers.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@caregrid.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:33:00Z
Subject: Re: PO approach and billing cadence questions for enterprise pilot

All —

Thanks, that approach is workable. A few clarifications from our side:

- We can include a committed annualized spend line. Our initial pilot commitment would be $120,000 annualized (50% prepay = $60,000).
- CareGrid prefers to avoid addendums if possible; can Redwood include the discount band language as an appendix to the PO instead of a separate signature? If legal requires a signature we can accommodate, but speed matters for our procurement window.
- Lockbox: we will use our centralized lockbox; please send remit details and the remittance mapping. Our AP team will accept a 3-business-day posting window.

I’ve attached an updated PO template with the committed spend line filled in. Could you return an annotated PO and the pricing summary by EOD Thursday?

Attachments: CareGrid_PO_Template.xlsx (updated)

Thanks,
Tara

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@caregrid.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: PO approach and billing cadence questions for enterprise pilot

Tara —

Attached: Redwood_PRICING_Tranche_Summary.pdf and an annotated PO with the appendix language inserted as a single-page pricing appendix (no separate signature required for the appendix for the pilot; we noted it as “accepted by mutual email confirmation” to keep procurement moving).

Highlights:
- Committed annualized spend: $120,000 -> qualifies for a 9% promotional discount for the first 12 months if the 50% prepay is received.
- Net 45 approved for this pilot pending receipt of the prepay tranche and standard credit screening.
- Lockbox remit details included on page 2 of the appendix; we’ll send a formal remit instruction PDF to your AP inbox.

Ben — please push the remit instructions to accounts-payable@caregrid.com and confirm the GL mapping. Vivek — after they sign/email acceptance, I’ll convert to PO and submit order to fulfillment.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_PRICING_Tranche_Summary.pdf, Annotated_PO_CareGrid.pdf
